[SWS_LOG_00001]
⌈
All messages logged before the initialization of the
Logging framework is done shall be stored inside a buffer with a limited size, i.e
the oldest entries are discarded if the buffer is exceeded. The size of the buffer is an
implementation detail.
⌋

[SWS_LOG_00001]
⌈
Log message logged before the Logging framework is able
to process them (e.g. daemon communication is not established) shall be queued.
The queue size is defined by LogAndTraceInstantiation.queueSize. If this size
is exceeded the oldest entries shall be discarded.
⌋

[SWS_LOG_00001] Queue Log Messages
⌈
Log messages that are logged while the Logging framework is not able to process
them (e.g. daemon communication is not established, Logging framework not yet
fully initialized) shall be queued. The queue size is defined by logSink.queueSize.
If this size is exceeded the oldest entries shall be discarded.
⌋

[SWS_LOG_00001] Queue Log Messages
⌈
Log messages that are logged while the Logging framework is not able to process
them (e.g. daemon communication is not established, Logging framework not yet
fully initialized) shall be queued. The queue size is defined by logSink.queueSize.
If this size is exceeded the oldest entries shall be discarded.
⌋
